$comment: GENERATED FILE. Import target for the Figma Variables sync plugin. Code is the source of truth: this file is written by `bun run tokens:build` and is overwritten on every run.

collections.name: Primitives
collections.description: Tier 1. Read-only in Figma: these are generated from code and overwritten on every sync, so edits here are lost. File a token change as a PR against packages/tokens/src/primitives.json.

collections.name: Semantic
collections.description: Tier 2. One mode per theme. Every variable aliases a Primitives variable, matching the code contract in packages/tokens/src/semantic.json.

variables.name: color/surface/sunken
variables.description: Recessed area on the canvas, e.g. a code block or well.

variables.name: color/surface/raised
variables.description: Card and panel background sitting above the canvas.

variables.name: color/surface/overlay
variables.description: Floating surface: modal, popover, tooltip, toast, select menu.

variables.name: color/surface/scrim
variables.description: Full-viewport wash behind a modal. Must be translucent.

variables.name: color/surface/control
variables.description: Default background for inputs and unfilled controls.

variables.name: color/surface/control-hover
variables.description: Input or control background on hover.

variables.name: color/surface/disabled
variables.description: Background for any disabled control. Never communicate disabled with opacity alone.

variables.name: color/surface/selected
variables.description: Background for a selected row, option, or tab.

variables.name: color/surface/accent-subtle
variables.description: Low-emphasis accent wash. Safe behind accent text.

variables.name: color/surface/accent-bold
variables.description: High-emphasis accent fill for primary actions.

variables.name: color/surface/neutral-subtle
variables.description: Low-emphasis neutral fill, e.g. secondary button rest.

variables.name: color/surface/success-subtle
variables.description: Success wash for badges and inline status.

variables.name: color/text/primary
variables.description: Default body and heading text. Must clear 4.5:1 on surface.canvas and surface.raised.

variables.name: color/text/secondary
variables.description: Supporting text. Must clear 4.5:1 on canvas.

variables.name: color/text/subtle
variables.description: De-emphasized metadata and helper text. Must clear 4.5:1 on canvas.

variables.name: color/text/placeholder
variables.description: Input placeholder. Must clear 4.5:1 on surface.control, since placeholders carry meaning.

variables.name: color/text/disabled
variables.description: Disabled control label. Exempt from AA by WCAG 1.4.3, but kept at 3:1 as a house rule.

variables.name: color/text/accent
variables.description: Accent-colored text on a neutral surface.

variables.name: color/text/success
variables.description: Success text on a neutral or success-subtle surface.

variables.name: color/border/subtle
variables.description: Hairline that defines structure without drawing attention. The system's default divider.

variables.name: color/border/default
variables.description: Structural border on a non-interactive container. Decorative by contract: never use it as the boundary of a control, that is what border.control exists for.

variables.name: color/border/strong
variables.description: Emphasized decorative border, e.g. a hovered card edge.

variables.name: color/border/control
variables.description: Resting boundary of an interactive control: input, select, checkbox, radio, switch track, secondary button. Must clear 3:1 against surface.control, surface.canvas and surface.raised in every theme. Enforced by the build, see contrast.json.

variables.name: color/border/control-hover
variables.description: Boundary of a hovered interactive control. Must clear 3:1 against surface.control-hover and must never be quieter than border.control.

variables.name: color/border/accent
variables.description: Accent border for selected or active elements.

variables.name: color/border/focus
variables.description: Focus ring color. Must clear 3:1 against every adjacent surface. Never overridden per-component.

variables.name: elevation/raised
variables.description: Card resting above the canvas. Most cards should use a border instead.

variables.name: elevation/modal
variables.description: Dialog. The highest elevation in the system.

variables.name: elevation/none
variables.description: Explicit no-shadow, so components can opt out without hardcoding `none`.

variables.name: radius/control
variables.description: Buttons, inputs, checkboxes, badges. Theme-owned, so Signal can be rounder.

variables.name: radius/pill
variables.description: Fully rounded, for pill badges and switches.

variables.name: font/mono
variables.description: Token values, code, and numeric tables.

collections.name: Component
collections.description: Tier 3. One mode per density. Aliases Semantic or Primitives. Component variables exist so a designer resizing a control changes one variable instead of every instance.
